title: Retail and offer card
caption: The retail-card recipe: a bold offer card with a big price, a badge popping over the corner, a shimmer sweep and a strong call-to-action button, for pricing and promotions.
prompt: Use the magnifito-variants skill to make a 7-second 16:9 offer clip for two Magnifito service packages in the retail-card style: "Website Starter, from €690" with a "Launch offer" badge, then "Social Media Care, €390 / month" with a "Monthly plan" badge, each 3.5 seconds with a "Book a call" button and the fine print "Illustrative prices for this showcase, VAT excluded". The prices are illustrative claims in claims.json. Brand: warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), dark ink #2b1c17, the logo green #8acf31 used sparingly, Geist from fonts/, and the logo in assets/magnifito-logo.svg. Render it with HyperFrames.
